title: A re-acquired publish slot token must be used for that pass's writes
description:
When the publish slot lease lapses and is re-acquired, the new token is not used for that pass's writes, so a lease lapse ends the run.

A lease that can lapse is the normal case for a long run, not an edge: the whole reason the slot exists is that runs outlive their leases. So this turns an expected event into a terminal one.

From pxc, finding 3906a9f0.
acceptance_criteria: A run whose publish lease lapses mid-pass re-acquires and completes that pass's writes with the new token, proven by a test that expires the lease deliberately
